stories.title: Three rare giant otter pups born at Chester Zoo take their first swimming lessons
stories.summary: Three giant otter pups born at Chester Zoo have had their first swimming lessons, 15 weeks after arriving in February. stories.title: Diocese told Flintshire Catholic school staff not to speak to BBC during filming visit, audit finds
stories.summary: The Catholic Diocese of Wrexham told staff at St Anthony’s Catholic Primary School in Saltney not to speak to a BBC film crew that arrived at the school in March 2025, an internal audit report has revealed. The instruction was sent by email on 11 March 2025 and forwarded to all staff at the school.
